meta.title: eRFX project level (all stages), one clause Required: the vendor accepts only the optional clause

plan.title: Required project T&C blocks vendor submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Set the project title required for publishing.
Configure the project with an RFQ stage only.
Apply the RFQ template and line items to the RFQ stage.
Select the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet, including editable line-item fields.

args.goal: on the RFQ eRFX create screen, open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set Payment within 45 days to Required, leave Delivery within 7 days as None, click Done, and stop with the project-level T&C configuration visibly saved

steps.note: Configure the two project-level clauses because no dedicated catalog step edits T&C clauses.
Invite one QA test vendor for the vendor-portal submission.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the RFQ project.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet and terms block as the vendor.
Confirm the required project-level clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the optional project-level clause is also shown.
Accept only the optional clause.
Attempt submission with the required clause still unchecked and verify Procol blocks the bid citing the required clause.
Accept the required clause after the blocked submission.
Submit the bid at 100 after all required terms are accepted.
Verify the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
